minimum_ready_test: temperature, humidity, smoke / PM, ventilation / filtration, backup power, and staffing are measured and kept within protective thresholds
common_failure: cooling center or shelter is open but indoor conditions are dangerous

minimum_ready_test: people without cars, smartphones, English, ID, or mobility can reach, enter, sleep, use toilets/showers, charge devices, and receive information
common_failure: site is technically open but functionally unreachable

minimum_ready_test: layout, lighting, toilets, sleeping, intake, complaints, and referrals reduce violence, coercion, abuse, and retaliation
common_failure: shelter use creates GBV, child protection, elder/disability abuse, or trafficking risk

minimum_ready_test: shelter connects people to claims, cash, legal help, temporary housing, repairs, schools, work, records, and transport
common_failure: people exit refuge into homelessness, paperwork, scams, or unsafe return

minimum_ready_test: pets and service animals can be sheltered or safely linked without separating handlers from service animals
common_failure: people stay behind or lose assistance because animals are excluded
